conflicts.permit: Where you choose to do this, we will receive certain profile information about you from your social media provider.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not receive any information from third parties.
conflicts.situation: When a user chooses to register or log in to the Services using a third-party social media account.
conflicts.reason: The summary explicitly states that the company does not receive any information from third parties, directly contradicting Section 7 which states profile information is received from social media providers.

conflicts.permit: We may request access or permission to track location-based information from your mobile device, either continuously or while you are using our mobile application(s), to provide certain location-based services.
conflicts.prohibit: G. Geolocation data Device location NO
conflicts.situation: Collecting device location data from a user's mobile device while using the mobile applications.
conflicts.reason: The CCPA table asserts that Geolocation data (device location) was not collected in the past 12 months, contradicting Section 1 where the policy states it tracks location-based information.
